entries.wording: Order created
Parcel handed to DPD
entries.note: Moves the result to in_transit; no milestone of its own, so the event stays unmapped for the sync to classify. Its verified parcelEvents twin is ORI.

entries.wording: Your parcel is on its way
entries.note: Moves the result to in_transit; no milestone of its own, so the event stays unmapped for the sync to classify.

entries.wording: At delivery center
entries.note: Moves the result to in_transit; no milestone of its own, so the event stays unmapped for the sync to classify.

entries.wording: Parcel out for delivery
Ready for collection
entries.note: The only value that unlocks the pickup-point name.

entries.wording: Unsuccessful delivery attempt
entries.note: A retry, not a terminal state: the result status stays in_transit.

entries.wording: Return to sender
entries.note: Terminal, reported with the exception status.

entries.wording: Delivered
Other tracking update
entries.note: The guest API's catch-all; neither a status nor a stage is derived from it.

entries.wording: Your parcel cleared customs successfully
entries.note: Scan code (Customs - Out) with no parcelHistory twin. Its country is the UNDEFINED placeholder, so the scan has no place.

entries.wording: Your parcel arrived at our depot
entries.note: Scan code (Origin depot - In), at the same instant as PARCEL_HANDED. Unmapped like its twin, so the event and the result stage both come from this wording; a stage here would disagree with the result stage and put accepted after customs on imports.

entries.wording: Your parcel is on its way
entries.note: Scan code worded like IN_TRANSIT, seen both before and after ORI. Unmapped like IN_TRANSIT: it names no milestone of its own.

entries.wording: Your parcel arrived at our hub
entries.note: Scan code: arrival at a hub.

entries.wording: Your parcel is ready to be transported to our next premises
entries.note: Scan code: the hub sends the parcel on.

entries.wording: Your parcel is on its way
entries.note: Scan code worded like IN_TRANSIT, seen between the hub and the delivery depot.

entries.wording: Your parcel arrived at our delivery depot
entries.note: Scan code (Destination depot - Inbound), at the same instant as AT_DELIVERY_CENTER.

entries.wording: Your parcel has been sorted and is ready for delivery
entries.note: Scan code: sorted at the delivery depot, before DLO.

entries.wording: Your parcel is at our delivery depot, it will soon be on its way
entries.note: Scan code: waiting at the delivery depot, before DLO.

entries.wording: Your parcel is out for delivery
entries.note: Scan code (Destination depot - Out for delivery), at the same instant as PARCEL_OUT_FOR_DELIVERY.

entries.wording: Your parcel has been delivered successfully
entries.note: Scan code (Delivery - Delivered), at the same instant as DELIVERED.

entries.wording: We received the proof of delivery
entries.note: Scan code (Delivery - Proof of delivery), minutes after DEY with no place. Dropped when a delivery scan is listed or the enumeration is not DELIVERED; staged delivered only when it is the sole delivery evidence of a delivered parcel. Its podUrl is never kept.

entries.wording: We have collected your parcel
entries.note: Scan code, the driver's pickup from the sender, seen on a German parcel between ENA and the origin depot.

entries.wording: Your parcel is on our premises, it will soon be on its way
entries.note: Scan code, seen on a German parcel before the line haul.

entries.wording: We couldn't deliver your parcel and had to return it to the depot
entries.note: Scan code: a failed delivery round, back at the delivery depot.

entries.wording: Your parcel is being held at our delivery depot, your premises were closed
entries.note: Scan code: a failed delivery round, the recipient's premises closed.

entries.wording: We couldn't deliver your parcel, it will soon be available at a retrieval point. You will be informed of the location upon arrival
entries.note: Scan code: a failed delivery round; the parcel goes on to a pickup point.

entries.wording: There was an issue to drop off your parcel due to a lack of space in the retrieval point
entries.note: Scan code: the round ended at a pickup point with no space for the parcel, which went back to the depot.

entries.wording: Your parcel has been delivered to the retrieval point, it will soon be available for collection
entries.note: Scan code: the parcel reaches the pickup point, which is no delivery to the recipient.

entries.wording: Your parcel has been delivered to the retrieval point
entries.note: Scan code: the parcel reaches the pickup point, which is no delivery to the recipient.

entries.wording: Your parcel is available at the retrieval point
entries.note: Scan code at the same instant as AVAILABLE_FOR_COLLECTION.

entries.wording: Your parcel is available at the retrieval point
entries.note: The notice of DODEI, sent without a place.

entries.wording: You have collected your parcel
entries.note: Scan code at the same instant as DELIVERED: the recipient collected the parcel from the pickup point.

entries.wording: We received the proof of delivery
entries.note: The proof of delivery after a collection from a pickup point, read like DEYY.

entries.wording: Your parcel is estimated to be delivered on: <date>
entries.note: A delivery estimate or a changed delivery day, not a scan; the date follows the colon.

entries.wording: We informed you via email that your parcel will be delivered on <date>
entries.note: The notice DPD emailed for the delivery round, not a scan.

entries.wording: We couldn't send a notification with your delivery details
entries.note: DPD failing to send the delivery details, not a scan: seen before and after the delivery round, it keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: Your parcel will be delivered to a safe place according to your instructions
entries.note: The recipient's delivery instruction, not a scan.

entries.wording: We received your delivery instructions
entries.note: The receipt of the recipient's delivery instruction, not a scan.

entries.wording: Your parcel will be delivered to a safe place according to your instructions
entries.note: The recipient's delivery instruction, as MIDLI words it, not a scan.

entries.wording: We are exchanging data internally
entries.note: A data exchange inside DPD's systems, not a scan; seen twice before the parcel reached the origin depot.

entries.wording: We received your labelling information
entries.note: Scan code: DPD receives the label data, the first scan of a German parcel left at a pickup point, before ENA.

entries.wording: Your parcel has been dropped off in the retrieval point
entries.note: Scan code: the sender hands the parcel in at a pickup point, after ENA and before DODEH.

entries.wording: Your parcel has been collected by the driver from the retrieval point
entries.note: Scan code: the driver takes the sender's hand-in from the pickup point on to the origin depot.

entries.wording: Your parcel is ready to be transported to our next premises
entries.note: Scan code worded like HUS, seen at the origin depot after DODEH.
